verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a Python SDK with clear operations (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget) and a CLI, giving AI-native users official building blocks, but the API reference lacks a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all probed endpoints 404) and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage beyond first-party docs. missing for 10: verifiable OpenAPI/REST SDK spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK reliability, multi-language SDK support beyond Python/CLI.
